project.name: Titan (engine defaults: not the project; the live dump replaces this)

notes.source: engine-defaults: values read from UE 5.8.2 source by the ue_parity audit (specs/ue_parity/DIFFERENCES.md, frame fact 1); Titan's DefaultEngine.ini overrides no render setting (CFG-01). A live dump from the UE editor leg replaces this file.
notes.light_units.k: OPEN CHOICE (captain): 683 lm/W, Blender's own glTF convention and the audit's working value (LGT-01, COL-08). 1 is the alternative; the picture is the same once exposure absorbs k.
notes.judgement_surface: OPEN CHOICE (captain): capture = the scripted SceneCapture recipe Titan already judges armour with (armour-render-ue.py); viewport and map:<name> are the alternatives.
notes.project.cvars.r.Material.EnergyConservat: OPEN CHOICE (captain): 0 = UE's legacy Default Lit (engine default, what Titan runs, SHD-02); the UE Default Lit group reproduces it. 1 would change every UE material; the group refuses that profile until it is rebuilt.
notes.preview.texture_compression: OPEN CHOICE (captain): source = Lampway samples the uncompressed maps (TEX-02 is reported, not previewed); bc_decoded is the alternative (cost).
notes.export.precision: OPEN CHOICE (captain): standard = UE's import defaults (8-bit tangents and weights, 16-bit UVs); hero = high-precision tangents, full-precision UVs, 16-bit weights for every export.
notes.exposure: UE's engine default is histogram AUTO exposure (COL-09), which Lampway cannot emulate; the profile pins MANUAL exposure at the physical-camera defaults (f/4, 1/60 s, ISO 100, bias 1.0) so a judgement is reproducible.
notes.tonemap_cube: null until set: the path of the 32^3 tonemapper cube, generated on the UE side (the captain's ruling, 2026-10-06: the generator lives outside Lampway; nothing of the tonemapper maths is in this repository). tonemap_cube_meta is the path of its JSON sidecar (lampway.ue-cube-meta/1: engine version, tonemapper settings, generator version, sha256, grid, domain, shaper). Lampway keeps only these paths and the hash, never a copy of the cube (docs/ue-look.md).
